findings.evidence: Bulk subscription uses a plain `supabase.from("user_games").insert(...)`; `user_games` has `UNIQUE(user_id, game_id)`. If the same user subscribes to a game in another tab or device after the modal opened, the whole insert fails and the modal shows `게임 구독에 실패했습니다`.
findings.impact: Rare multi-tab race leaves the user unable to complete onboarding without manually deselecting the already-subscribed game; no data corruption (RLS and the unique constraint hold).
findings.recommendation: Use `upsert(..., { onConflict: "user_id,game_id", ignoreDuplicates: true })` for the bulk subscription in a follow-up.

findings.evidence: Order and onboarding keys (`chronoledger:game-order:<userId>`, `chronoledger:game-onboarding-dismissed:<userId>`) are never removed on logout or account deletion, unlike the account-deletion token cleanup in `src/lib/auth-context.tsx:137`.
findings.impact: Low-sensitivity game ids and a dismissal flag persist in the browser after logout/deletion on shared devices; a re-created account gets a new user id, so behaviour is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Optionally clear `chronoledger:game-*:<userId>` keys on sign-out and account deletion; can be folded into the R50 auth security review.
